description: Initial absence-of-evidence baseline; never infer acceptance from workflows.yaml or CI.

runs.steps_to_reproduce: Packaged Desktop (electron-builder --dir, Electron 44.11) > People > Start Ada: Runner combobox lists installed runners; claude selectable.
runs.observed: claude detected and selectable; session argv used --session-id (assign strategy).

runs.steps_to_reproduce: Packaged Desktop (electron-builder --dir, Electron 44.11) > People > Start Ada with ATK_PROVIDER=codex: Runner combobox, select codex.
runs.observed: codex detected/authenticated (ChatGPT login) and selectable; session started against fixture-repo.

runs.steps_to_reproduce: Start Ada with the real sum-fix task (not emptied) and Start and open terminal.
runs.observed: Durable session record created (status running), PTY opened on fixture-repo, provider process claude --session-id <uuid> alive.

runs.steps_to_reproduce: Start Ada with the real sum-fix task and Start and open terminal.
runs.observed: Durable session record created, PTY opened on fixture-repo, real Codex session ran the task.

runs.steps_to_reproduce: Observe terminal while Claude works; wait for fixture tests to pass.
runs.observed: Raw PTY stream only (no structured tool events in interactive path); Claude ran tests, edited src/sum.mjs (a-b -> a+b), re-ran tests green. Fixture diff 191 bytes verified outside the app.

runs.steps_to_reproduce: Observe terminal while Codex works; wait for fixture tests to pass.
runs.observed: Raw PTY stream in interactive path; Codex edited src/sum.mjs (a-b -> a+b) and fixture node --test passes; diff 191 bytes verified outside the app.

runs.steps_to_reproduce: Answer interactive provider prompts in the terminal; then People > Stop session > confirm.
runs.observed: Interactive import/trust prompt answered with Enter (safe default); Stop ended the session and history shows STOPPED.

runs.steps_to_reproduce: Answer interactive provider prompts in the terminal; then People > Stop session > confirm.
runs.observed: One interactive prompt answered with Enter; Stop ended the session and People history shows STOPPED (1 label). World index listed "Ada fixture-repo running" while active.

runs.steps_to_reproduce: After completion, inspect fixture git diff and test result; session record on disk.
runs.observed: git diff shows exactly the one-line fix; node --test passes; session record status stopped with provider_session_id captured.

runs.steps_to_reproduce: After completion, inspect fixture git diff and test result; session record on disk.
runs.observed: git diff shows exactly the one-line fix (191 bytes); node --test passes; durable session record session_1794452551_12451_3382.json present.

runs.steps_to_reproduce: Quit the packaged app, relaunch it against the same workspace, open People.
runs.observed: Ada shows CONFIGURED · OFFLINE with 2 sessions in Recent sessions (STOPPED), durable records intact; no phantom running state.

runs.steps_to_reproduce: Quit the packaged app, relaunch it against the same workspace, open People.
runs.observed: Ada shows CONFIGURED - OFFLINE, RECENT SESSIONS lists fixture-repo/codex STOPPED with START AGAIN; 1 durable record intact; no phantom running state. (Harness counted badges before render in this run; screenshot is the evidence.)

limitations: Gate 0 remains unverified overall: D01 (true first-run onboarding) was pre-seeded in this trial and is still unverified; D02-D07 are proven only for claude on linux-x86_64. Codex/OpenCode traversals, the failure-condition matrix, 1024x640/1440x900/1920x1080 + keyboard/reduced-motion audit, and macOS/Windows installers remain outstanding.

Packaged binary required Electron ^44.11.0: the previously pinned 44.4.5 segfaults on kernel 7.2 (see PR fixing the pin). Trial ran under ozone headless (no physical display) with system GL swiftshader.
The interactive session path streams raw PTY bytes only; structured tool-call events exist only in headless provider modes (see ADR-043 spike measurements).
Provider credential hygiene: the trial rotated the operator OAuth token; the maintainer must re-run `claude /login` for their own CLI after such trials.
